item.title: Offline AI models on Phones & PC - April 2026
item.description: Intro Today I want to talk about, Google Gemma 4; this sets a new standard for open source AI models. I am astonished by the quality of this, though it has a small model size compared to the other big ones out there.. like Kimi K2.5 from Moonshot AI, that thing is a 1 trillion parameter model.. 1 trillion! and Gemma 4’s biggest is only 31 billion.. but here is the thing, Kimi K2.
